mapper.select: select scvb.value template_type,scvb.meaning templateTypeCn from sys_code_value_b scvb,sys_code_b scb where scvb.code_id = scb.code_id and scb.code = 'SYS.TEMPLATE_TYPE'
select scvb.value send_type,scvb.meaning sendTypeCn from sys_code_value_b scvb,sys_code_b scb where scvb.code_id = scb.code_id and scb.code = 'SYS.SEND_TYPE'

select smt.*, (select v.meaning as value_name from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'SMS_MESSAGE_TYPE' and v.code_value=smt.TEMPLATE_type) as TEMPLATE_TYPE_n, (select v.meaning as value_name from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'SYS.YES_NO' and v.code_value=smt.enable) as enable_n from SYS_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE smt where smt.TEMPLATE_type in('PHONE_MESSAGE')
